basic_info.description: Step into this stylish 2-bed, 2-bath condo located in the heart of San Francisco’s vibrant Mission District. With 985 sqft of modern living space, in-unit laundry, and fresh paint throughout, this home offers both comfort and city living at its best. Enjoy stunning city views, easy access to chic dining, casual eateries and entertainment on Valencia Street. A short walk to the iconic Dolores Park and cafes. The building includes amenities like a rooftop deck with panoramic city views, a dedicated parking spot, and onsite secure bike parking. The unbeatable location is just two blocks from BART, offering a 99/100 Walk Score, making it a walker’s, rider’s, and biker’s paradise.
